witnesses.reuseNote: Used as a comparison witness. No publisher page image or modern editorial annotation is copied into the reader. This does not establish redistribution or narration permission.

observations.finding: After the report corresponding to selected 835, the print opens Kitab al-Jumuah. It does not have the two later numbered occurrences found at this boundary in the modern print.
After modern 873 (selected 835), the print repeats the heading Women praying behind men and includes two separately numbered occurrences, 874 and 875.

Both tail occurrences appear as 884 and 885 in chapter 163. They agree lexically with modern 874 and 875 under the stated unvowelled transcription policy. The printed note records omission in Abu Dharr and identifies the repeated chapter; further notes record Ibn Asakir variants.

commentaryEvidence.label: Al-Qastallani · Irshad al-Sari · online page 154
commentaryEvidence.locator: Chapter 166 m, after reports 874–875 and before the Friday Prayer book
commentaryEvidence.excerpt: وزاد في فرع اليونينية ، كهي ، هنا باب صلاة النساء خلف الرجال ، وهو ثابت فيه قبل ببابين ، فكرره فيه ونبّه على سقوط الأخير في الهامش بإزائه عند أبي ذر ، وهو ساقط في جميع الأصول التي وقفت عليها لكونه لا فائدة في تكريره . نعم ، فيه : حين يقضي تسليمه وهو يمكث ، وفي السابق : حين يقضي تسليمه ويمكث ، هو ، وفيه أيضًا : قالت ، بتاء التأنيث ، ولابن عساكر : قال : بالتذكير . وفي الأول : قال ، فقط وفي الأخير ، قدّم حديث أبي نعيم على حديث يحيى بن قزعة .
commentaryEvidence.finding: Records the repeated chapter in a Yunini branch, omission in Abu Dharr and in copies the commentator inspected, reversal of the two report positions, and the feminine qalat reading with masculine qala attributed to Ibn Asakir. This supports preserving the occurrence and its variants; it does not certify this transcription or English.
